Prototype · 2026-11-07 · Fable · no app code touched

My Shop and Plans at 820 and 1440 — the phone unchanged

The ask (owner, 7 Nov, live My Shop at desktop width): "the page doesn't look like a dashboard well thought of" · "shop and plan doesn't seem to have a tablet/desktop view". On a 1440 screen /vendor-dashboard/shop is one phone column (48 rem, tab:max-w-3xl) centred with empty space either side; /vendor-dashboard/subscription is narrower still (36 rem, max-w-xl) and has no pinned row at all.

What this does: keeps every row, label, number and action the shipped pages have, and changes only the layout at 820 and 1440 — by dropping both pages into the two columns the supplier frame already ships (SupplierColumns, supplier-frame.css · the list left, the opened item right · 1 : 1 from 701, 5 : 6 from 1100) that Today, Customers › Events and the Hub already use, and that the owner-approved v13 drawing gives Shop › Services. One delta reaches the phone: the black "Finish profile" button, which breaks the button rule at every width.

Rule 0 — what exists · what is missing · the delta

  • Exists (shipped): app/vendor-dashboard/shop/page.tsx (HeroCard · ShopSegments pinned row · ShopServiceRows · the "Your shop" DatesRows · ServicesDisclosure · Manpower fold · SupplierThumbRow) · subscription/_components/plan-screen.tsx + plan-rows.tsx + plan-picker.tsx · the frame: layout.tsx (boundary="tab", pinnedBar), _components/supplier-columns.tsx (.sn-cols), supplier-open-row.tsx, supplier-frame.css, pin-door.tsx, supplier-thumb-row.tsx (from 701 the thumb row moves up into the bar's [data-pin-tools]).
  • Exists (design): supplier dashboard v13, owner "Approved." 29 Oct — setnayan-handoff-src/carry-2026-10-29/supplier-dashboard-proto/index.html + V13-BUILD-NOTES.md (S1 shell: "two columns (list · opened item)"; S5 Shop › Services) — its desktop/tablet shots are embedded below. Also prototypes/desktop_layouts_2026-10-22.html family 2 (one shell, 48/64-rem columns — the ruling v13 then widened for Today, Events and Hub), prototypes/vendor_dashboard_redesign_2026-09-22.html ("Set up your shop · five steps") and prototypes/vendor_dashboard_rearranged_2026-08-26.html (where the 46 screens live) — both phone-only drawings; neither draws a width above 430.
  • Missing: My Shop and Plans never took the v13 two columns — the guard the-columns-are-the-system.test.ts still pins Shop › Services to the 48-rem reading column (the 22 Oct ruling), and Plans is not in that guard at all. Plans has no pinned row.
  • Delta drawn here: both pages in SupplierColumns from 701; the pane's default = the shop card (My Shop) / "What Free gives you" (Plans); a pinned row on Plans; the hero CTA on the button rule. Nothing else moves; the phone keeps its rows in the shipped order.

House rules used (cited where each change says so)

  • Always maximize the screen — owner 29 Oct ("remember to always maximize the screen use"): on tablet/desktop use the width (side panel, columns) instead of a centred phone strip; no crushed columns.
  • The pinned row is the template — owner 27 Oct: one pinned row per page: selector · counts · one action · ⚙ (DECISION_LOG "THE PINNED ROW IS THE APP-WIDE TEMPLATE"; v13 "EVERY SUPPLIER-DASHBOARD PAGE: THE TOP ROWS COMPRESS INTO ONE PINNED ROW").
  • BUTTON_RULE_2026-10-07 (BUTTON_RULE_2026-10-07_fable.md): every control is a 44-px pill, icon + word; one colour per meaning — terracotta = forward/save, green = Done/money, grey = Cancel, red = Remove.
  • Frames only on what you press; dividers between topics — owner 2026-10-11. Details go inside the ⓘ — owner 23 Oct. Rows: tap opens, swipe left removes — owner 4 Nov. Any set of choices is a dropdown — DECISION_LOG 2026-09-28.
  • MY SHOP WALK — SEVEN OWNER FINDINGS — DECISION_LOG 2026-09-23 (⓸ "Why add save buttons?", ⓺ one fact two writers, "there are a lot of inconsistencies on this shop page") — the inconsistency list at the end continues that walk.
  • Prototypes use the app's real tokens — owner 4 Nov: this file's :root is copied from apps/web/app/globals.css (light + html.dark), font Hanken Grotesk.

2 · My Shop — proposal at 1440 and 820

The page drops into SupplierColumns name="shop" from 701. Left = every row the phone has, in the phone's order: the Services rows, then the "Your shop" door rows, then the folds. Right = the pane, never empty: its default is the shop card (the hero: logo · name · verification pill · plan · service · city · address · profile ring · the one next step) — the thing every row below is about. Tap a row and it opens beside itself (SupplierOpenRow, the soft accent wash on the current row); the shop card returns when nothing is open.

3 · Plans — proposal at 1440 and 820

Plans is one screen in two seats (PlanScreen: the page, and the Shop ⚙ › "Plan and billing" fold). The page's own column is max-w-xl (36 rem) — narrower than every other supplier page — and it has no pinned row. Proposal: the same two columns; left = the answer line + every row as shipped (plan-rows.tsx, plan-picker.tsx); right = the first fold opened by default, "What Free gives you" (read from your plan), and whichever fold or row is tapped after. The Add-ons cards, today a second page below the rows, become what the "Add-ons ›" row opens in the pane.

6 · What could not be captured from the real page · open calls

  • My Shop itself (/vendor-dashboard/shop) has no dev lab and needs a signed-in shop with a database; on a dummy env it redirects to /login. The "shipped" frame in § 1 is drawn from shop/page.tsx and the owner's 7 Nov description — the verification pill, address line, ring and rows are the code's own words. The real page also draws CouplePhotosToAnswer (only when photos wait), the Packages door (behind NEXT_PUBLIC_PACKAGE_AUTHORING) and Auto-reply (behind its flag) — Auto-reply is drawn, Packages is not.
  • The real frame around Plans: supplier-plan-lab has no &shell=1, so the baseline is the body alone (the lab says so). The frame drawn around it is the one captured on supplier-lab.
  • Dark: the app is light-locked (html.dark inert); the dark captures and the ◐ toggle here use the shipped dark block as written.
  • Open calls for the owner: (a) the Plans pinned row's figures — word-first doors ("Free · plan") or the answer line as text; (b) whether the shop card should stay the pane's default or move to a Details-style figures row ("Live · ✓ verified · 88% profile") as v13 drew it — this proposal keeps the card because the ask was "keep every row, change only the layout"; (c) the three doors to verification (pill · row · ⚙ fold) — which one stays.
  • Not a build. Build note if approved: shop/page.tsx and plan-screen.tsx each wrap their body in SupplierColumns + SupplierOpenScope, their outermost column goes tab:max-w-none, and the two guards (the-columns-are-the-system.test.ts, the-shop-sections-are-v13.test.ts) are updated in the same PR — never weakened.
